response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates solid software engineering fundamentals and versatility across multiple languages and domains, the resume shows a critical gap in core competencies for this Principal role: experimentation platforms, metrics infrastructure, telemetry systems, and statistical analysis. His background has been primarily in full-stack development, DevOps, and GIS systems rather than growth/experimentation systems. Without demonstrated expertise in the domain-specific technologies and patterns central to this position, he would require significant ramp-up even at the Staff level, making him unsuitable for a Principal-level hire.
strengths: Extensive multi-language proficiency (JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C, C++, C#) and proven full-stack capability across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Demonstrated ability to work on high-scale systems (Dunnhumby: millions of HTTP requests/second) with focus on performance optimization and infrastructure
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, testing practices, and knowledge sharing through workshops, open source contributions, and community engagement
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, feature-flagging systems, or experimentation quality/bias detection
Absence of any background in metrics infrastructure, telemetry systems, data analysis, or statistical methods—all core to the Growth/Experimentation role
Limited evidence of Principal-level technical leadership or architecture influence; background suggests individual contributor roles rather than defining systemic patterns enabling multiple teams

key_factors.factor: No Data Analysis or Statistical Methods Background
Strong Multi-Language Technical Foundation and Scale Experience
